name: whatsapp-connect-mcp
description: Read, search, and send WhatsApp messages from any MCP client, with every outbound send protected by a server-enforced draft-and-confirm gate.
long_description: A WhatsApp MCP server shipped as a single static Go binary. Sixteen tools cover chats, messages, contacts, calls, and media, plus a built-in `doctor` diagnostic. Every outbound send goes through a draft-first confirmation gate and a rate limiter, mitigating (never eliminating) the account-ban risk inherent to the unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol this project relies on. Run `whatsapp-connect-mcp setup` once, outside this client, to pair a device before use.
